proposed_from.topic: Exact three-arm face/corner second-order minimax constant and allocation frontier for binary finite-population contrasts. For arbitrary binary complete schedules and every assignment law independent of them, compare unrestricted minimax squared-error risk with iid q*=(1/2,1/4,1/4) for contrast (1,-1/2,-1/2). Prove both deficits from 1/n converge after n^(4/3) scaling to the same explicit Airy constant; derive the arm-labelled stratified face/corner decision experiment from the exact eight-type orbit game; and construct matching finite-n estimators and complete-schedule priors. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: the eight-type tangent program yields V(theta,eta)=max(|theta|/2,|eta|/4), a half-wedge Airy operator, a label-preserving half-effect prior, and an allocation-regularizing broad-prior mixture; exact arithmetic reproduces the n=3 label gap. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: close the singular eta=0 experiment and finite-orbit bridge with uniform upper/lower remainders. EARLY KILL TEST: verify the posterior-target coefficient and uniform allocation square completion. seed_details.title: Exact three-arm half-wedge Airy constant with the local allocation frontier
seed_details.anchor: SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026, Theorems 2.1--2.3 and 3.1, pages 5--9; MukerjeeDasguptaRubin2018, Sections 2--3 and Theorem 1
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the scalar shifted-binomial reduction and the inequality \(r\le n-|\theta|\) by the exact eight-type orbit likelihood and its two-coordinate tangent program; the first new object is \(V(\theta,\eta)=\max\{|\theta|/2,|\eta|/4\}\).
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for the exact three-arm target paired with orbit reduction, Airy minimax analysis, or an allocation frontier found only the two-arm papers and regular multi-arm variance theory.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Sudijono, Dobriban, and Tchetgen Tchetgen because four binary schedule types merely become eight.
seed_details.rebuttal: The eight labelled types do not collapse to their scalar sufficient statistic: intersecting face and corner strata, arm-dependent posterior coefficients, and the singular \(\eta=0\) fiber require a new risk bridge and a different spectral normalization.

seed_details.title: Sharp \(n^{-1/6}\) allocation frontier around \(q^\star\)
seed_details.anchor: Bai2023, Theorems 3.1--3.3; SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026, Theorem 3.1; ZhaoDing2023, Sections 2--3
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Retain the constrained Hessian remainder in the Neyman allocation criterion and couple it uniformly to the nonregular orbit experiment rather than fixing the limiting allocation before the second-order analysis.
seed_details.destination_search: No located paper treats \(n\)-dependent multi-arm allocations at the scale where first-order allocation loss competes with an Airy correction.
seed_details.red_team: The frontier is only a Taylor expansion of the Neyman allocation formula.
seed_details.rebuttal: The Taylor polynomial identifies a candidate penalty but does not prove that the unrestricted nonlinear estimator, labelled likelihood, and least-favorable prior have a uniform \(n^{-4/3}\) expansion along \(q_n=q^\star+O(n^{-1/6})\).

seed_details.title: Contrast-weight phase diagram for three-arm tangent cones
seed_details.anchor: MukerjeeDasguptaRubin2018, Section 2; Bai2023, Theorem 3.2; SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026, Theorem 3.1
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the fixed symmetric contrast by a contrast-indexed support function of the projected eight-type cube and locate changes in its active faces.
seed_details.destination_search: General multi-treatment contrasts are covered by regular variance theory, but no contrast-indexed nonregular minimax phase diagram was located.
seed_details.red_team: This is a routine parameterized version of one symmetric contrast.
seed_details.rebuttal: A credible version must prove where the tangent cone and operator domain change and establish both sides of each phase boundary; this is absent from the fixed-contrast calculation.

seed_details.title: Uniform finite-orbit bridge at the singular fiber
seed_details.anchor: Prior proposal exp_boundedcluster_endpoint_orbit_minimax, proof-independence-frontier after equation (41); SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026, Appendix C
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace positive-cell pointwise likelihood convergence by a direct risk comparison that preserves dormant primal constraints and arbitrary posterior versions on disappearing cells.
seed_details.destination_search: The scalar lattice argument in the two-arm paper and classical operator bounds do not treat a rank-degenerate labelled experiment with a measure-valued transverse limit.
seed_details.red_team: Null-cell posterior versions cannot affect risk and hence the boundary is only bookkeeping.
seed_details.rebuttal: A cell null under the limiting prior can remain an active worst-case constraint in the finite primal game, so deleting it can change the minimax envelope at the claimed scale.

seed_details.title: Unrestricted fixed-count complete-randomization constant
seed_details.anchor: Hull2026, Proposition 2 and the conjecture following Theorem 1; SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026, Section 4
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the product Bernoulli likelihood and its discrete Stein identity by the coupled labelled multivariate-hypergeometric orbit while leaving the estimator unrestricted.
seed_details.destination_search: The located strict fixed-count result is affine-class only; no unrestricted three-arm sharp constant was found.
seed_details.red_team: Hull already proves complete randomization is worse.
seed_details.rebuttal: Hull's strict result restricts the estimator class, while his unrestricted theorem optimizes over the design and does not evaluate a fixed-count design.

seed_details.title: Polyhedral Airy constants for every fixed number of arms
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Derive a nonredundant tangent map from \(2^K\) schedule types before invoking a spectral lower bound; a formal multivariate Laplacian has the wrong rank.
seed_details.destination_search: No fixed-\(K\) sharp second-order theorem was located; the available multi-arm results are first-order or regular.
seed_details.red_team: The multivariate Rayleigh-quotient extension is automatic.
seed_details.rebuttal: The orbit polytope, diffusion rank, active domain, and interface conditions must first be derived and change with the contrast; none follows by replacing one derivative with a gradient.

seed_details.title: Finite-\(n\) iid-optimality and label-gap classification
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Eliminate the abstract primal and dual variables from the arm-labelled complementary-slackness system to obtain a symbolic active-set criterion.
seed_details.destination_search: The prior finite game proves existence but stops before classification, and the published convex program is two-arm.
seed_details.red_team: This merely solves a finite convex program separately for each \(n\).
seed_details.rebuttal: The contribution would be a necessary-and-sufficient symbolic classification and proof of the first label gap, not numerical optimization.

seed_details.title: Critical prognostic-strength frontier for independent versus stratified assignment
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Intersect the endpoint cube with a within-stratum dispersion restriction, which destroys the separability of the endpoint adversary.
seed_details.destination_search: Existing stratification results impose prognostic structure or fix conventional estimators; none jointly optimizes unrestricted nonlinear estimators over bounded schedules.
seed_details.red_team: Bai and Kallus already show informative stratification is optimal.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those results do not derive the critical transition against independent allocation in the bounded fixed-schedule unrestricted-estimator game.

seed_details.title: Exact weak-null inversion for the nonlinear three-arm minimax rule
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace sharp-null imputation by maximization over compatible eight-type counts under a weak finite-population contrast null.
seed_details.destination_search: No exact weak-null inversion based on the three-arm minimax orbit rule was located.
seed_details.red_team: Invert the usual Fisher randomization test.
seed_details.rebuttal: The target is a weak null with unidentified complete schedules, so sharp-null imputation is unavailable and nuisance maximization is load-bearing.

seed_details.title: Endpoint reduction for bounded three-arm outcomes
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Apply coordinatewise endpoint Bernoulliization and conditional expectation to the multi-arm observation map.
seed_details.destination_search: The two-arm endpoint contraction is explicit in both anchors; no concrete obstruction to extending the same argument across a finite arm set was found.
seed_details.red_team: The binary subclass gives one inequality and conditional endpoint randomization gives the other verbatim.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds absent a finite-\(n\) labelled counterexample.
